title: beyond99-banknote-detection
description: Code, results and paper for open-set evaluation of counterfeit banknote detectors: ten supervised classifiers, four one-class detectors and four hybrids on the UCI Banknote Authentication data, scored by leave-one-family-out (LOFO) on counterfeit families withheld from training at a fixed 1% genuine-rejection budget, with mean and worst-family detection, robustness over family granularity and budget, a mechanism analysis and ready-to-use trained detectors. Companion software to the preprint "Beyond 99%: Open-Set Evaluation Reveals Silent Failures of Counterfeit Banknote Detectors, and the Case for One-Class Screening".
